traps.why: Bromine water keeps going until every ortho/para position carries a Br. For a single bromine use Br₂/CHCl₃, cold.
The OH directs ortho/para, never meta.

explanation: One bromine goes para to the OH when para is open; when para is blocked it goes ortho. Existing substituents stay.
tip: Para if open, else ortho. Never meta, never replacing a group.
